Aisha (People Ops): Hey team — onboarding for Marta (starting Monday). We have an I-9 doc exception: she'll be remote and can't make the office. Need a mobile verification or courier. Anyone available to coordinate? :wave:

Jonas (IT): I can do courier for laptop dropoff Mon morning. Do we have an approved courier vendor?

Aisha (People Ops): Thanks Jonas. We normally use "BlueShip" (account code +5551). Can you confirm cost and ETA? Also need ID verification for I-9. Leah, do we have mobile notaries in approved vendor list?

Leah (HR): Yes — two options: in-person mobile notary (partner: NotaryNow) or video I-9 via DHS-compliant vendor (requires pre-approval). For remote hires we prefer mobile notary for I-9 physical docs. I'll initiate a PO. 

Devon (Hiring Manager): Marta's timezone is PST. If we schedule courier Mon 9–11am PST that's ideal. @Marta, can you confirm availability for that window?

Marta (New Hire): Confirmed — Mon 9:30am PST works. Also I have my passport and driver license ready. Thanks!

Jonas (IT): Great. I'll book BlueShip pickup for 9:15am Mon and mark laptop as "on hold" in inventory. Tracking: BK-78342 (I'll DM the tracking once booked). Who signs for the mobile notary? Does the notary need host contact?

Leah (HR): Notary needs an authorized witness contact. @Aisha can be the contact; please share phone: 415-555-0123. I'll submit the request now and attach the notary confirmation when approved.

Aisha (People Ops): Phone shared via DM to Leah. Also note: Marta's BG check is still pending final disposition — hr-bot update below.

hr-bot: Background check status for Marta (candidate ID 99821): Identity confirmed; MVR/Employment verification pending. Expected completion: 48–72 hours. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Devon (Hiring Manager): Ok. As long as identity is confirmed and notary can verify docs, we can proceed with orientation access. Badge Team — can you pre-provision temporary digital badge and Zoom orientation invite for Mon 10am PST? 

Badge Team: Will do — temp badge issued for Marta (expires in 7 days). Sending calendar invite now. Marta — you should receive an email with Zoom + Campus access QR. 

Aisha (People Ops): Quick checklist for courier & notary:
```
- Book BlueShip pickup Mon 9:15am PST (Jonas)
- Mobile notary scheduled Mon 9–11am PST (Leah)
- Laptop hold + tracking (Jonas)
- Temp badge + Zoom invite (Badge Team)
- Confirm BG check clear before full access (Leah/hr-bot)
- Send new-hire welcome packet + benefits enrollment link (Aisha)
```

Marta (New Hire): Got the calendar invite and badge email. Appreciate the quick turnaround! :smile:

Jonas (IT): Filed laptop pickup ticket #IT-4521 and set delivery note: "Leave w/ Notary if Marta not present". I'll post tracking later.

Aisha (People Ops): Thanks everyone. I'll update this thread when notary PO is approved and when hr-bot posts final BG status. :pray:
